verdict.rationale: RudderStack Profiles resolves identities into a customer 360 in the warehouse. Entities are declared in version-controlled YAML, which generates warehouse-native SQL that handles identity resolution, so the rules are documented and configurable. The product also claims identity graphs built from any combination of unique identifiers across any number of sources. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of anonymous-to-known stitching and cross-device merging, detail on the configurable matching rules themselves, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
